mug matches P7 (rank 1.1) and P9 (rank 0.1). P7 has no stock, so only P9 remains; its description says a mug is not included. The quoted phrase green tea matches P3 (rank 1.1) and P7 (rank 0.1); only P3 remains in stock. mug -teapot excludes P9 lexically and leaves P7, which stock eligibility removes. It therefore returns no rows. Scores use ts_rank_cd with default weights and no length normalisation. The teaching stages distinguish decisions; they are not a trace of executor evaluation order.
